name: Lewd Love Stories
source:
The worst part of visual novels is waiting weeks for an update that is 99% text and sex scenes that made it not worth the wait. That's why I've created Lewd Love Stories. Every week there will be a new story or a new chapter to an ongoing story. Some stories will be short and sweet, and others will be played over multiple chapters. Each chapter will provide enough story to get you invested and enough sex scenes to keep you satisfied. The first story is Girl Next Door, containing three parts, will show childhood friends Ellie and David become closer than ever.

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/lewd-love-stories-v0-1-stone-eyes.43099/]F95zone[/url]]
translation:
视觉小说最糟糕的部分是等待数周的更新，其中99% 的文字和性爱场景让它不值得等待。这就是我创作《淫荡爱情故事》的原因。每周都会有一个新故事或正在进行的故事的新章节。有些故事简短而甜蜜，而另一些故事则分为多个章节。每一章都会提供足够的故事让你投入，足够的性爱场景让你满意。第一个故事是邻家女孩，包含三个部分，将展示儿时好友艾莉和大卫变得比以往任何时候都更加亲密。

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/lewd-love-stories-v0-1-stone-eyes.43099/]F95zone[/url]]
